title: Bad nginx deploy
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the web (nginx) component, attributes the issue to the nginx 1.28 update (deploy), and cites the update as the triggering cause.
root_cause: The nginx:1.28 update changed the upstream configuration, causing nginx to time out when connecting to the API backend, which results in 500 errors for users.
truth: The new nginx version 1.28 introduced a regression that causes it to return 500 Internal Server Error for all requests.
